sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Taste Skill is an agent skill that helps coding agents build polished company websites instead of generic landing pages. It gives the agent a design system, curated palettes, fonts, layouts and real photographs, and checks the result in a real browser.
sixtySeconds.problem: Websites built by AI agents often look templated and break on different screen sizes. Taste Skill deals tested layouts and tokens for the kind of business, and runs a checker in headless Chrome before the agent hands the page over.
whoFor: People asking coding agents to build or redesign company websites
Developers who want consistent, professional landing pages
Designers who use Claude Code or Codex for frontend work
Agencies building many small business sites
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it if you want an agent to produce a high-quality marketing site with built-in checks. It's focused on company websites, not app interfaces.
requirements: Chrome, Edge or Chromium installed (set CHROME_PATH if it's in a non-standard place)
Optional: ffmpeg for WebP output and phone crops

overview: When you ask your agent to build or redesign a company site, it loads the skill, copies its assets into your project, starts from a starter HTML page and runs a checker before handing the page over. Each build starts by classifying the business, such as software, gaming, tech, product, service or place.

Scripts deal a palette made for the trade and a Google Fonts pairing, pick one of eleven tested hero layouts, add vetted photographs with credits, and resolve real brand and interface icons into local SVGs. Shader effects and 3D touches are used only on software, tech and gaming pages.

The checker renders the page in headless Chrome over HTTP at 1440, 1024, 820, 768 and 390 pixels wide and prints PASS, WARN or FAIL per rule, catching empty visuals, broken shaders and layout problems. All tools are plain Node scripts that install nothing.
